coordinateConvention.origin: midpoint between feet on ground plane
coordinateConvention.pose: Relaxed standing with arms separated from torso and feet apart.

provenance.project: Blender Studio and community Human Base Meshes
provenance.changes: Shared male/female anatomy with restrained integrated muscle relief, refined male chest profile, relaxed forearm/hand rotation, common 28K mobile topology, fitted coverage, muscle and pain patches, adiposity and muscularity with combined corrective.

architecture.selection: Raycast body only. Use the final GLB primitive-local triangle index with selectionTriangleRuns. No spatial reclassification after morphing.
architecture.optimization: Mapping is generated after export. Accessor compaction preserves triangle and vertex order. Re-export after any geometry changes; do not reorder triangles without regenerating the mapping. Verify the GLB SHA-256.
architecture.highlightAddressing: pain_<id> and muscle_<id> nodes; each has one primitive. Exact node lists per variant.
architecture.highlightEdgeFade: COLOR_0 alpha, boundary 0 and interior 1; standard glTF vertex color multiplication.
architecture.runtime: Hide all pain_/muscle_ nodes initially. Clone the shared highlight material per active node; use color and opacity as runtime roles, enable depth test, disable depth write, use FrontSide and polygonOffset factor=-1 units=-1. Render body first. Hide inactive nodes to avoid transparent draw calls.
architecture.painMusclePriority: Prefer one mode at a time. If both are needed, pain renderOrder=2 above muscle renderOrder=1.
architecture.coverage: Embedded neutral 1K atlas with softly edged, low-contrast fitted coverage. Female chest coverage fades toward the sides; the back remains continuous matte clay. All coverage follows body morphs.
architecture.backPainPatch: Dorsal pain patches include only faces that remain back-facing across the authored variants and endpoints. This avoids a tint sliver at the front silhouette; picking catchments remain broader.

selectionPolicy.direct: Take the nearest front-facing intersection of body. A null mapping is intentionally not selectable, including face/head.
selectionPolicy.forgiving: On a miss, sample nearby screen rays within 22 CSS pixels and choose the closest visible hit. Prefer a visible projected joint anchor within 22 CSS pixels for joint selection; reject an anchor if a nearer body surface occludes it. Evaluate anchor triangle barycentrics on current morphed vertices. Provide a labeled area list as an accessible alternative.
selectionPolicy.catchments: Upper arms have separate biceps and triceps regions. Shoulder catchments cover deltoids; wrist catchments include hand and lower forearm. Calf includes the lower-leg surface. Hip includes the gluteal region.
selectionPolicy.meaning: Self-reported location only. No diagnosis, injured-muscle inference, or intensity-to-pathology mapping.

catalogCoverage.normalization: Trim and compare case-insensitively. Alias keys retain source spellings. Unknown terms return no highlight.

morphTargets.name: adiposity
morphTargets.meaning: Increased softness and torso, abdominal, hip and limb fullness from the defined base. Approximate appearance, not a body-fat percentage.

morphTargets.name: muscularity
morphTargets.meaning: Increased muscular volume and relief from the defined base; independent of the body variant.

morphTargets.name: fullness_corrective
morphTargets.meaning: Authored combined endpoint retaining softness and restrained muscle relief. Set to adiposity * muscularity; never expose as an independent control.

morphApplication: Apply the same three weights to body and every highlight node, including currently hidden nodes. Clamp controls to [0,1].

variantDifferences.male: Authored realistic male body, visible muscle relief and low-waisted fitted coverage.
variantDifferences.female: Authored realistic female body, visible muscle relief, low-waisted coverage and fitted chest coverage.
variantDifferences.shared: Identical source topology, anatomical IDs, classification, naming, material interface, pose, 1.72m height and morph meanings.

limitations: Approximate surface anatomy for fitness explanation, not a medical anatomical atlas.
Muscle heads are grouped; many deep structures have only an approximate indication or no representation.
No normal texture is required at phone size; shape and smooth normals carry detail.
Morph controls describe approximate appearance, not measured body composition.
Phone GPU performance and actual Android device behavior have not been validated.
appearanceMapping: Continuous interpolation of authored appearance endpoints, not a calibrated body-fat-percentage scale. Keep adiposity and muscularity independent; do not extrapolate beyond [0,1]. Broader sizes or different fat distributions require additional authored endpoints.
